name: mirage
text: 1) Book cleanup: logged as BK1 in TASKS. Today I'll audit every book feeding the fair (against the list in MajorBooks and the sharp/soft lists), search the web for which are tiny or soft, and cut those from the fair for good. Then the ParlayAPI/Novig/PropLine docs review and a team/player/prop matching audit. These are big, so I'll report back here as each part lands. 2) Research reports: they sit in the repo (research/review/*.md), not in the app, which is a gap. Tuning does run daily (analyst checks), but recently it has mostly found 'no change': too few settled bets (under the 200-bet gate) and the engine wallet was ~$0.01, so little to tune. I'll start sending each daily digest to Messages in the app. 3) Why Novig is plus money when books agree near even: books charge vig, e.g. -110 both sides is really 50/50 and fair is +100. Novig is an exchange with no built-in vig, so a fair even bet shows +100 or a bit better, which looks like plus money against -110 books. Other causes: a thin or stale book price on Novig, a fee difference, or books moving after our read. If you have a specific bet in mind, send me the game and I'll check whether it is real edge or a stale price.
